edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the from address of _transfer via _msgSender().
msg.sender is the spender used in transferFrom allowance update.
block.timestamp governs sniper detection, wallet caps and jeet windows inside _transfer.
launchTime is set from block.timestamp in setTrading.
_transfer calls burnTokens internally during the swap branch.
burnTokens re-enters _transfer from within the outer transfer flow.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when the swap threshold is reached.
swapTokensForEth reaches into the external router swap operation.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee to forward accumulated ETH.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to the marketing address.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with an externally supplied amount.
manualsend forwards the whole ETH balance via sendETHToFee.
The destination of the ETH transfer comes from _marketingAddress.
setMarketingWallet overwrites _marketingAddress and is gated on it.
Caller identity is compared against _marketingAddress to authorize the wallet change.
manualswap is authorized by comparing _msgSender() with _marketingAddress.
manualsend is authorized by comparing _msgSender() with _marketingAddress.
_buyMap stores block.timestamp to decide jeet fees on sells.
Sniper flagging depends on comparing block.timestamp with launchTime.
_isSniper blacklist checks constrain transfers in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the amount in _transfer.
_maxWalletSize bounds recipient balance in _transfer.
_swapTokensAtAmount sets the swap trigger in _transfer.
_minimumBuyAmount caps buys during the anti-snipe window.
tradingOpen gates execution of non-owner transfers.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch.
inSwap guards against recursive swap execution.
_burnFee determines the burn amount before swapping.
_redisFee feeds the reflection fee used in the transfer math.
_taxFee feeds the team fee used in the transfer math.
launchTime defines the timestamp-dependent anti-snipe window.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
_transfer hands accounting off to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard for balance updates.
_transferStandard writes sender and recipient _rOwned balances.
setTrading writes launchTime from block.timestamp.
addSniper writes sniper flags into _isSniper.
Owner-only setter mutating _taxFee used in transfer math.
Owner-only setter mutating _burnFee used before swaps.
Owner-only setter mutating jeet reflection fee state.
from parameter drives the source side of the internal transfer.
to parameter drives the destination side of the internal transfer.
amount parameter is bounded and forwarded into the token transfer.
Constructor grants the deployer the entire initial reflection supply.
Constructor initializes _rOwned for the deployer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only meaningful as the source argument of _transfer and should be normalized into that core function.
Parameter to is only meaningful as the destination argument of _transfer.
Parameter amount is consumed solely by the limit checks and transfer logic in _transfer.
Parameter sender exists only to feed _transfer from the transferFrom entrypoint.
Parameter recipient exists only to feed _transfer from the transfer entrypoint.
Parameter snipers is iterated purely to populate _isSniper inside addSniper.
Sniper address parameter is used only for the owner-controlled blacklist operation.
Parameter marketingAddress is only used to overwrite the marketing wallet state.
Parameter tAmount is only used as the amount input for reflection accounting.
Local contractTokenBalance is a transient helper value inside _transfer.
Local burntAmount is derived for and immediately passed to the burn operation.
Local contractETHBalance is only used to feed the ETH fee transfer.
Local takeFee is a control flag computed and consumed entirely within _transfer.
Local canSwap is a transient branch condition in _transfer.
